Re: Request for review of the out-of-school suspension of [Student first name], grade [X], issued September 22, 2026

Dear [Principal name]:

I am the parent or guardian of [Student first name]. I am writing to request a review of the 7-school-day out-of-school suspension issued on September 22, 2026, as provided under 105 ILCS 5/10-22.6(b), and to request the complete written suspension decision.

The notice I received does not include the rationale for the length of the suspension or whether other appropriate and available interventions were attempted before a suspension longer than three days was imposed. Each of these must appear in the written decision under 105 ILCS 5/10-22.6(b) and (b-20). Please provide a complete written decision that includes them.

Because [Student first name] has an IEP and this removal brings the total days removed this school year to 12, I request a manifestation determination review within ten school days of the removal decision, as required by 34 CFR 300.530(e), together with the procedural safeguards notice required by 34 CFR 300.530(h). Please share all records the team will rely on before the meeting.

I also request copies of [Student first name]'s school student records related to this incident, including the referral, any statements, and any record of interventions, under the Illinois School Student Records Act (105 ILCS 10/5).

Please confirm in writing what support services will be provided during the suspension, as required for suspensions longer than four school days under 105 ILCS 5/10-22.6(b-25), and that [Student first name] will be permitted to make up all missed work for equivalent academic credit under 105 ILCS 5/10-22.6(b-30).

Please confirm the date of the review and send the requested documents to me at the address or email below.

Sincerely,

[Parent or guardian name]
